853:t_53:11.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Cut it out, $$ＡＧ$$. I said stop it.」

853:t_53:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're strong and cute! You're simply the best! Please let me call you Big Sis too!」

853:t_53:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... You went cold on me in an instant...」

853:t_54:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You truly are the $$トップレス$$ representative...! Are you used to celebrations like these?」

853:t_54:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But those are more like ceremonies. Having someone congratulate me personally like this isn't bad.」

853:t_54:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You have a surprisingly cute side, $$ラルク$$.」

853:t_54:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-idiot! What are you talking about!?」

853:t_54:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're even cuter when you're embarrassed! You're so, so cute, $$ラルク$$!」

853:t_54:11.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Cut it out, $$ＡＧ$$. I said stop it.」

853:t_54:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're strong and cute! You're simply the best! Please let me call you Big Sis too!」

853:t_54:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... You went cold on me in an instant...」

853:t_55:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are so cold, $$チコ$$. Life won't be much fun if you're like that at your age.」

853:t_55:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here is a gift to suit your chilly attitude: an ice pop.」

853:t_55:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Did you know what I like, by any chance...?」

853:t_55:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know how it is. Information is a dimensional trader's lifeblood.」

853:t_55:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This fine specimen was frozen at minus 1.2 trillion degrees. Please enjoy it.」

853:t_55:11.en:
$$チコ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I'll have it now.」

853:t_55:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If I get to see you smile, $$チコ$$, preparing it was worth the effort.」

853:t_56:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. So, what's the extra prize?」

853:t_56:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are you going to unsettle me by ordering tea and making some remark about '$$あがり$$'?」

853:t_56:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wrong! My plan was to spot the sweet pickled ginger and say, 'Ah, gari!'」

853:t_56:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Ugh... I didn't see that one coming...」

853:t_57:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That refreshing smile of yours could make me fall in love.」

853:t_57:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Why doesn't $$ミレーヌ$$ notice your charms, $$ガムリン$$...?」

853:t_57:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I-I don't think that's true! $$ミレーヌ$$ does pay attention to me!」

853:t_57:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「N-no... That's wrong! Acting with $$ミレーヌ$$'s eyes on me in mind is impure!」

853:t_57:10.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I must improve myself further and have $$ミレーヌ$$ see... No! That still makes it about her eyes on me...」

853:t_57:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(He is a capable soldier with a pure boy's heart... That must be what makes $$ガムリン$$ so charming...)

853:t_58:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, you don't like counting them as kills...」

853:t_58:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let me rephrase it! Over 80 fans have had their hearts shot through by your songs, $$バサラ$$!」

853:t_58:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「All right! A thousand, ten thousand... No, I'll keep singing until I've shot through every last person's heart!!」

853:t_58:8.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「You are as simple as ever...」

853:t_58:9.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「That's the kind of man $$バサラ$$ is.」

853:t_58:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a fan myself, I look forward to seeing what miracles your songs bring about, $$バサラ$$.」

853:t_59:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「This is just a milestone. I'll grow much, much stronger.」

853:t_59:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you're putting your feelings on your wings...」

853:t_59:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't you ever feel those feelings weighing you down?」

853:t_59:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, it isn't. People's feelings can sometimes become heavy, heavy shackles that bind them.」

853:t_59:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll fly anyway. I have wings that can carry even those burdens.」

853:t_59:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Sometimes he shows such resolve, freedom, and manly charm... It's no wonder people fall head over heels for him...)

853:t_60:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I have my pride as $$スカル１$$, too. It'll be a while yet before I hand my place as an ace over to those rookies.」

853:t_60:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Does that mean you plan to hand the captain's position to someone else someday too...?」

853:t_60:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That was just a figure of speech. I don't intend to lose to anyone.」

853:t_60:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I won't lose, so I can protect the woman I love.」

853:t_60:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since you brought it up, do say that in front of $$キャシー$$.」

853:t_61:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I've steadily devoted myself to support, but with my skills, this much is a cinch.」

853:t_61:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really are a sniper! You always take down the prey and girls you aim for!」

853:t_61:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Even so, I've been missing my shots with the girls lately.」

853:t_61:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then why not shoot straight through the target you've been carefully lining up all this time?」

853:t_61:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'll do it without you telling me. Staying childhood friends who aren't quite lovers forever is frustrating.」

853:t_62:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. But I didn't do this on my own.」

853:t_62:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. Your loyal servants, $$シモン#uav$$, $$ヨハネ$$, and $$ペテロ$$, deserve credit too, $$ルカ$$.」

853:t_62:6.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's more than that. $$ナナセ$$ gives me strength.」

853:t_62:8.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's it! I'll tell $$ナナセ$$ about this and have her congratulate me!」

853:t_62:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That would be the best present of all for me!」

853:t_62:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...So my congratulations aren't worth a damn...」

853:t_63:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「Yes... Now I can hold my head up before $$ネネ$$ and $$ララミア$$ too.」
